entity_types: Fondazione (Law 1 July 2015 n.101; public notarial deed, ATS Registro delle Fondazioni) and Associazione non-profit (ANR/AR registers) under the consolidated CGeG law on non-profit associations and foundations; ONLUS by ATS act.
cost_time: ATS registration is FREE (Art.11: 'L'iscrizione nei Registri e gratuita'); Art.32: ATS grants foundation registration within 10 days of the application. Notary deed cost unpublished (as of 2026); the deed itself is tax-exempt (Art.29).
foreign_no_presence: yes for fondazioni (Art.2 and Art.29: non-Sammarinese natural/legal persons may found, subject to AML-equivalence of home state; no residency required; non-resident president must elect domicile at the seat); partial for associazioni (Art.2/16: members mostly resident in the Republic).
corrections: Law 1 July 2015 n.101 (Fondazioni) is real; ATS registration is free and decided within 10 days, not ~$200 / 1-3 months.
